## Summary

Describe the logistics task the skill should support.

## Domain

Primary domain family:

Related skillset or specialization, if any:

## Trigger

When should an agent use this skill?

## Non-Trigger Boundary

When should an agent avoid this skill or escalate instead?

## Required Inputs

List the information the skill needs to produce a useful output.

## Expected Output

Describe the operational output the skill should produce.

## Evidence And Sources

Link authoritative sources for regulations, standards, safety-sensitive claims,
or calculations. Include jurisdiction and applicability when relevant.

## Safety Or Approval Boundaries

State any legal, regulatory, engineering, equipment, operator, financial,
customer, food safety, dangerous-goods, customs, or live-system approvals the
skill must not claim to provide.

## Validation

Describe scenario, fixture, evaluation, or validator updates needed for this
change.
